title: TRTL-913 (GABA-A positive allosteric modulator) Phase 2a for tinnitus
whyItMatters: One of only two Phase 2+ drug trials in the world targeting tinnitus as the primary indication. Note: Part A doses healthy volunteers; only Part B is in tinnitus patients. Tortugas launched April 2026 with $106M to develop the ex-Hansoh compound.

title: Etanercept (TNF-α inhibitor) vs saline for blast-induced tinnitus
whyItMatters: Tests an anti-inflammatory mechanism in a defined subtype (blast-induced tinnitus) — primary completion is this month.

title: taVNS paired with tailor-made notched music (double-blind RCT)
whyItMatters: The largest non-invasive VNS program in tinnitus — the first adequately sized test of the ear-clip approach consumer devices already imitate.

title: Anti-CGRP monoclonals (galcanezumab/erenumab) for tinnitus with migraine features
whyItMatters: First test of migraine biology as a tinnitus target in the subgroup with migraine features.

title: BosSTENT dedicated venous stent for pulsatile tinnitus
whyItMatters: First dedicated-device trial in a field running on off-label stents with ~90% observational resolution rates.

title: Mild therapeutic hypothermia (mastoid cooling) for tinnitus — sham-controlled
whyItMatters: A genuinely novel mechanism category — small sham-controlled first test.

title: Dedicated tinnitus implant evaluation
whyItMatters: The largest implant manufacturer testing an implant aimed at tinnitus rather than hearing.

title: SPI-1005 (ebselen) open-label Phase 3 safety study in Meniere's disease
whyItMatters: The most advanced drug program with tinnitus-relevant outcomes; enrollment completed July 2026. Tinnitus is a secondary, patient-reported outcome.

title: Bimodal electrical-sound stimulation + auditory training (NITESGON-ADT)
whyItMatters: Academic (non-company) bimodal stimulation trial from the Dublin group — a step toward independent evidence for the bimodal approach.

title: Somatosensory tinnitus randomized controlled trial
whyItMatters: A properly controlled trial for the somatic subtype, where physical treatment might actually change the percept.

title: Oto smartphone app vs standard care
status: Listed 'Recruiting' — registry stale (not updated since Oct 2024; primary completion date has passed)
sponsor: East and North Hertfordshire NHS Trust
whyItMatters: Independent NHS evaluation of a commercial tinnitus app — exactly the kind of non-manufacturer evidence digital therapeutics need. Watch for results despite the stale registration.

title: Navigated rTMS for chronic tinnitus
whyItMatters: Tests whether individually navigated targeting fixes rTMS's durability problem.

title: Personalized-target continuous theta-burst stimulation
whyItMatters: Large personalized brain-stimulation trial.

title: WHITBY: home-based tDCS feasibility
whyItMatters: Feasibility step toward a definitive UK tDCS trial.

title: Internet-based mindfulness-based cognitive therapy (iMBCT)
whyItMatters: Tests whether MBCT's in-person results survive online delivery.

title: Somatic tracking (attention-based) for tinnitus
status: Listed 'Recruiting' — registry stale (not updated since Mar 2025; primary completion date has passed)
whyItMatters: Attention-retraining approach borrowed from chronic-pain research.

title: Cochlear implantation effects on tinnitus
whyItMatters: Large prospective dataset on which implanted patients improve.

title: Deep brain stimulation for severe refractory tinnitus
whyItMatters: Tiny first-in-kind study — invasive, for the most severe cases only.

title: Acoustic + electrical stimulation for tinnitus
whyItMatters: Independent US academic work on combined acoustic-electrical stimulation.

title: EEG biomarker study with the Lenire device
whyItMatters: Looks for an objective brain-response marker of who responds to bimodal stimulation.

title: Interventional acoustic stimulation for chronic tinnitus
sponsor: First Affiliated Hospital, Nanjing Medical University
whyItMatters: Large acoustic-stimulation trial.
